exactResults.sourceBasisCovariance: For an invertible real source change O'=S O, rho'=S rho S^T and det(rho')=det(S)^2 det(rho); rank and positivity are invariant.
exactResults.projectiveCovariance: State ratios transform by the projective bijection r'=(a r+b)/(c r+d); an invertible source change preserves distinct projective directions.
exactResults.improvementAtFixedMomentum: T improvement shifts O_g by kappa(s) O_H. At each fixed s this shifts every finite ratio by the same kappa(s), preserving ratio differences and spectral rank.
exactResults.contactQuotient: Hermitian local real counterterm polynomials have zero absorptive discontinuity on the ordinary real cut, so rho is the scheme-stable primary object.
exactResults.vacuumOpenImageNoGo: A Lorentz-invariant vacuum family parameterized only by invariant mass s has local image dimension at most one, even when samples at separated s linearly span H2(R).

gaugeAndCohomologyGate.physicalStatement: Gauge independence is assigned only to matrix elements of renormalized gauge-invariant sources between BRST-cohomology states after the gauge, Goldstone and ghost completion.
gaugeAndCohomologyGate.quotientStatement: BRST-exact and equation-of-motion insertions are null only in the physical on-shell/cohomological quotient; dropping them diagram by diagram is not licensed.
gaugeAndCohomologyGate.abelianStrikeStatus: structural witness, not a completed gauge-fixed amplitude calculation

realStructureGate.automaticObject: rho_ab is complex Hermitian positive semidefinite in general
realStructureGate.realReductionCondition: A common antiunitary symmetry preserving the state and making both Hermitian scalar sources even permits a real source basis and H2(R).
realStructureGate.disposition: H2(C) is canonical until the antiunitary real structure is certified; H2(R) is a conditional reduction.

reentry: An open metric-Higgs image requires at least three independently effective physical controls and a verified rank-three Jacobian; candidate controls include temperature, spatial momentum and Higgs background.
